_comment: Killer Power add-ons the scrape source doesn't carry, hand-transcribed from that killer's own wiki page. Gated on releasedAt like everything else (scripts/release-gate.ts). Kept deliberately small: an entry is dead weight the moment the source catches up. The way to check whether one is still needed is to remove it and re-run the scraper — NOT to compare it against addons.json, which already contains whatever this file put there. That circular check is exactly how The Slasher nearly lost all twenty of its add-ons.

addons.name: Bent Wheel
addons.description: "All that remained of the victim's wheelchair after the fatal blow." Increases the Jump Scare targeting range by +4 metres.

addons.name: Garden Claw
addons.description: "Good for digging up weeds and digging into human flesh." Increases the duration of Killer Instinct after a Jump Scare by +2 seconds.

addons.name: Knitting Needle
addons.description: "You won't believe what—and who—this thing has been through." Increases the time it takes for Survivors to remove an impaled Hook Spike from themselves by +20 %.

addons.name: Orderly's Shoe
addons.description: "It hung from her twitching foot as the knife plunged into her belly." Increases the duration of the Haste Status Effect after a Jump Scare by +5 seconds.

addons.name: Bloody Smile
addons.description: "He wasn't happy after his face was smashed into a tree." Increase the detection ranges of Jump Scare and Omnipresent Evil by +4 metres.

addons.name: Coroner's Coffee
addons.description: "A cup of coffee that went unfinished." Increases the duration of Throwing Spike's push by +25 %. Gain +13 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds after injuring a Survivor with a Throwing Spike if they do not collide with the environment during the push.

addons.name: Party Noisemaker
addons.description: "A party instrument that tore through a woman's eyeball and gouged her brain." Breaking a Pallet or a Breakable Wall with Jump Scare reveals all Survivors further than 28 metres for 6 seconds.

addons.name: Sleeping Bag
addons.description: "An absolutely awful place to hide from a killer." After grabbing a Hook Spike while in Omnipresent Evil, Survivors who are within 10 metres of any Hook have their location revealed for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Toxic Waste
addons.description: "No one could survive being submerged in this poison." After performing a Jump Scare, Survivors within 10 metres of a Hook or a Scrap Pile are inflicted with the Oblivious Status Effect for 13 seconds.

addons.name: Eye Goop
addons.description: "What remains when a harpoon is shoved into one's eye." Gain the Undetectable Status Effect after grabbing a Hook Spike for 13 seconds.

addons.name: Imprinted Aluminum
addons.description: "It's either avant-garde artwork, or the horrified imprint of a woman whose face was slammed into it." Injuring a healthy Survivor with a Throwing Spike inflicts them with the Mangled and Haemorrhage Status Effects for 70 seconds.

addons.name: Mirror Shards
addons.description: "A weapon that dealt more than bad luck." Survivors are inflicted with the Broken Status Effect after extracting a Hook Spike from themselves for 40 seconds.

addons.name: Sauna Rock
addons.description: "Nicely weighted, could be used to crush a rib cage." After performing a Jump Scare, inflict all detected Survivors with the Exhausted Status Effect for 3 seconds.

addons.name: Two Nails
addons.description: "A reliable way to hold a corpse's wrist in place." Survivors that come within 1 metre of a Throwing Spike have their Aura revealed for 5 seconds.

addons.name: Bloody Magazine
addons.description: "The spattering of blood told the story of a brutal massacre." When a Hook Spike misses, all Survivors within 8 metres of the Hook Spike's impact zone scream and reveal their Auras for 3 seconds.

addons.name: Burnt Fuse
addons.description: "The surge of electricity was overwhelming. It left the man's flesh charred and smelling of cooked meat." When a Survivor is impaled by a Hook Spike, the Exit Gates are blocked for them and any Survivor within 13 metres. This effect persists for 5 seconds after the Survivor is no longer impaled.

addons.name: Deputy's Badge
addons.description: "The badge of an officer who discovered that some things aren't worth investigating." While in Omnipresent Evil, passing within 2 metres of a Generator causes the Generator to explode, lose -5 % progress and begin regressing. If a Survivor is repairing the Generator, all Survivors repairing it will instead get a special Skill Check. If the Skill Check is failed, the Generator loses -10 % additional progress on top of the base Skill Check penalty.

addons.name: Missing Corkscrew
addons.description: "It seems to always be missing when you need it on-hand." When a Survivor is impaled by a Hook Spike, they emit a 32 metre Terror Radius until the Hook Spike is removed. Gain the Undetectable Status Effect when impaling a Survivor with a Hook Spike. This effect persists for 13 seconds after the Survivor is no longer impaled.

addons.name: Dirty Money
addons.description: "No amount of money can save you from him." When a Generator is repaired, gain 2 tokens. When you vault a Window or break a Pallet or a Breakable Wall, consume 1 token and gain a regular Spike if you don't have one already.

addons.name: Iridescent Boat Motor
addons.description: "The blades are chipped and cracked, as if having cut through something solid." Passing through Windows while in Omnipresent Evil marks them for 13 seconds. Performing a Jump Scare blocks all marked Windows for 13 seconds.
